finding: Worker Arrow digest framing adds bounded temporary arrays concurrently. Active thread digests increased from one readback to four source workers; largest batches remained 25,000 rows. Spawned worker Arrow high-water allocation rose from 64.0 to 106.5 MiB. After source completion, 17,536 Arrow bytes remained for cached constant prefixes; RSS retains allocator reservations. Record batch and row group limits remain 25,000 and 200,000; slow input buffers remain 10,000. Higher matched RSS is an accepted documented cost of the measured implementation, not a demonstrated memory reduction.

digest.interpretation: Arrow byte counts are process-wide and can include concurrent conversions. At-hash observations retain the framing and joined-row arrays. RSS includes allocator reservations.
